name: holaOS agent fitness
description: 8 agent-loop tasks run against a simulated workspace (in-memory files, no real commands). Each task runs under two conditions: 'full' sends the real holaOS system prompt and tool list, 'lean' sends 8 core tools from the same snapshot and a short system prompt. Graded by program.

full.description: Real holaOS main-session request: system prompt and tool list captured from the runtime's request pipeline on a fresh workspace with no integrations, MCP servers or browser. Paths, dates and timezone replaced with neutral placeholders.
full.user_suffix:
Runtime context:

[Runtime Context 1]
Current user context:
The current operator timezone is `UTC`.
Interpret relative dates and times such as `today`, `tomorrow`, `this morning`, and `end of day` in that timezone unless the user says otherwise.
[/Runtime Context 1]

lean.description: 8 core tools copied unchanged from the full snapshot (read, edit, bash, search, find, ls, search_web, ask_user_question) and a short system prompt. holaOS has no write tool; new files are created with bash in both conditions.

token_note: approx_tokens measured with one model's tokenizer and chat template; other models differ by roughly 10-20%.

tasks.prompt: Which port does the database use, according to config/app.yaml? Reply with just the port number.
